title: Human Resources & Talent
completion_message: ¡Perfecto! El vocabulario de Recursos Humanos es esencial para cualquier ejecutivo. Ahora puedes hablar con propiedad sobre procesos de selección, retención de talento, evaluaciones de desempeño y reestructuración organizacional.

stages.title: Recursos Humanos y Gestión del Talento (C1)

parts.visual:
Procesos de RRHH: 
- Onboarding (Proceso de integración / El proceso de incorporar a un nuevo empleado a la empresa). 
Ej: Our onboarding process takes three weeks. 
- Performance review (Evaluación de desempeño / Reunión formal para evaluar el trabajo de un empleado). 
Ej: I have my annual performance review tomorrow. 
- Retention (Retención / La capacidad de mantener a los empleados en la empresa). 
Ej: High salaries improve employee retention.
parts.audio: Human Resources Processes. 'Onboarding' is the process of integrating a new employee into a company. For example: Our onboarding process takes three weeks. A 'Performance review' is a formal assessment of an employee's work. For example: I have my annual performance review tomorrow. 'Retention' refers to the ability of an organization to keep its employees. For example: High salaries improve employee retention.

parts.visual:
Compensación y Salida: 
- Severance package (Indemnización / Compensación económica que se le da a un empleado al ser despedido). 
Ej: After being laid off, he received a generous severance package. 
- Redundancy (Despido por reestructuración / Cuando un puesto de trabajo ya no es necesario). 
Ej: Due to automation, 50 jobs were made redundant. 
- Headhunter (Cazatalentos / Un reclutador especializado que busca candidatos para posiciones directivas). 
Ej: A headhunter contacted her about a VP role at Google.
parts.audio: Compensation and Exit. A 'Severance package' is a payment or other compensation offered to an employee upon dismissal. For example: After being laid off, he received a generous severance package. 'Redundancy' occurs when a job is no longer needed, often due to restructuring. For example: Due to automation, 50 jobs were made redundant. A 'Headhunter' is a recruiter who specializes in finding candidates for senior positions. For example: A headhunter contacted her about a VP role at Google.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término de Recursos Humanos correcto.

questions.question: The process of welcoming and integrating new employees into the company is called ____. (Incorporación).
questions.explanation: Onboarding = proceso de integración de nuevos empleados.

questions.question: My manager will assess my progress in my annual ____ review. (Evaluación de desempeño).
Offering flexible working hours is a great strategy to improve employee ____. (Retención).
After 15 years at the company, he was laid off with a generous ____ package. (Indemnización).
questions.explanation: Severance package = paquete de indemnización por despido.

questions.question: The factory closed and 200 positions were made ____. (Innecesarios / Suprimidos).
questions.explanation: Made redundant = suprimido (el puesto ya no existe).

questions.question: A ____ called me to offer me a C-suite position at a rival firm. (Cazatalentos).
A special bonus paid to retain key executives is called a retention ____. (Bonificación de retención).
questions.explanation: Retention bonus = bonificación para que el empleado no se vaya a otra empresa.

questions.question: The company needs to hire more people. HR is going to ____ 50 new employees. (Reclutar).
When someone voluntarily leaves their job, they ____. (Renunciar).
questions.explanation: Resign = renunciar formalmente a un puesto.

questions.question: The ability of an employee to grow in their career within a company is called career ____. (Desarrollo profesional).
The company issued a ____ notice telling 50 employees they would lose their jobs. (Aviso de despido).
questions.explanation: Redundancy notice = aviso formal de despido por reestructuración.

questions.question: The total value of an employee's salary, bonuses, and benefits is called the ____ package. (Paquete de compensación).
questions.explanation: Compensation package = paquete de compensación total.

questions.question: A ____ is the target an employee must achieve to earn their bonus. (Meta de desempeño / Objetivo).
questions.explanation: KPI = Key Performance Indicator (Indicador Clave de Desempeño).

questions.question: When a company fires many employees at once to cut costs, this is called a ____. (Despido masivo).
questions.explanation: Layoff = despido masivo por causas económicas, no disciplinarias.

questions.question: Allowing employees to work from home is called ____ work. (Trabajo remoto).
questions.explanation: Remote work = trabajo remoto / a distancia.

questions.question: A company's written set of rules and guidelines for employees is the employee ____. (Manual del empleado).
The rate at which employees leave and are replaced is called staff ____. (Rotación de personal).
questions.explanation: Staff turnover = rotación de personal (qué tan frecuente se remplaza gente).

questions.question: A program to help an employee improve before potential dismissal is a ____ improvement plan. (Plan de mejora de desempeño).
questions.explanation: Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) = plan formal de mejora de desempeño.

questions.question: When an employee leaves voluntarily to work for a competitor, it is called ____. (Fuga de talento).
questions.explanation: Brain drain = fuga de cerebros/talento (a otra empresa o país).

questions.question: The department responsible for managing employees, contracts, and payroll is called ____. (Recursos Humanos).
